items.title: The Phantom (Billy Zane) roams thejungle on his dependable horse, Hero.
Escaping the tiger's cage at the Central Park Zoo is no challenge to The Phantom (Billy Zane).
As part of his plan to capture the power of a strange and ancient civilization, Xander Drax (Treat Williams) acquires two of the skulls of Touganda.
